import numpy as np

def transform_to_grid(I):
    """
    Transform input grid I to double-sized output.
    Pattern: tile with 4 rotations arranged diagonally
    """
    n = len(I)
    result = np.zeros((2*n, 2*n), dtype=int)

    result[:n, n:] = np.rot90(I, k=3)   # top-right: 270° CCW / 90° CW
    result[n:, :n] = np.rot90(I, k=1)   # bottom-left: 90° CCW
    result[n:, n:] = np.rot90(I, k=2)   # bottom-right: 180°
    
    return result
